schinese.description: 扮演札莉卡，让50名特工倒向你这边。
schinese.name: EG2_ACH_099

schinese.description: 扮演札莉卡，完成所有研究。
schinese.name: EG2_ACH_100

schinese.description: 扮演札莉卡，偷取一只已灭绝的生物、一只还未孵化的生物，以及一份来自另一个世界的宝藏。
schinese.name: EG2_ACH_101

english.description: Help Carmina get back to her mother in Prosperity. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_1

english.description: Upgrade and secure Prosperity. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_2

english.description: Bring the Father back to New Eden. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_3

english.description: Solve the biggest problem in Hope County by defeating the Twins. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_4

english.description: Decide the fate of the Father. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_5

english.description: Recover Grace's prototype gun and welcome her back to Prosperity for good. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_6

english.description: Return Selene's valuable stash. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_7

english.description: Help Bean get back his business plan so he can set up his intel network in Prosperity. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_8

english.description: Reunite Nick Rye with Carmina and Kim. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_9

english.description: Complete your first Expedition to force the Highwaymen out of a stronghold.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_10

english.description: Gather intel 10 times by talking to Wiki-Bean-ia scouts. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_11

english.description: Loot a Highwaymen Supply Drop. Be careful, it won't be unguarded!
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_12

english.description: Gather 15 plants growing in Hope County. It's the closest thing to a pharmacy we have nowadays.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_13

english.description: Scavenge an Outpost. You can always reclaim it. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_14

english.description: Upgrade Prosperity's infrastructure for the first time by investing in the right parts. Host only.
english.displayName: Home is Where the Part Is
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_15

english.description: Drive with Timber for a total of 5 minutes. Just don't take him to the vet.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_16

english.description: Commandeer an Ethanol tanker and bring it back to one of your outposts.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_17

english.description: Complete 3 Treasure Hunt missions. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_18

english.description: Picklock 5 safes. With no more banks, it's the closest thing you'll get to experiencing a heist.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_19

english.description: Recruit all Guns For Hire. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_20

english.description: Craft 10 Medkits. They'll definitely come in handy.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_21

english.description: Kill a Monstrous animal. It'd do the same to you given half the chance.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_22

english.description: Find Sam Fisher’s outfit in the Government Plane Wreck expedition
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_23

english.description: Find all the Dear Photograph locations and see Hope County as it used to be. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_24

english.description: Rediscover some sweet tunes for the new world. Find all hidden MP3 players. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_25

english.description: Make Prosperity better than ever! Build all Infrastructure upgrades available. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_26

english.description: Collect at least one skin from every type of animal in Hope County. Not creepy at all.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_27

english.description: Complete 7 unique Expeditions on the Rank III difficulty.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_28

english.description: Liberate a Rank III Outpost while staying undetected.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_29

english.description: Liberate all Outposts at least once on Rank III.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_30

english.description: Craft 3 weapons. They don't need to look good, they just need to get the job done!
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_31

english.description: Successfully catch one of every type of fish in Hope County. Get those omega-3s.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_32

english.description: Recruit Horatio. Don't mind his temper, he can be pig-headed sometimes. Host only.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_33

english.description: Use 3 smoke grenades.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_34

english.description: Headshot an Enforcer with Piercing Ammo.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_35

english.description: Complete 3 Expeditions with a co-op partner.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_36

english.description: Kill 25 enemies using any type of takedown. Put that railroad spike to good use!
english.displayName: Bring a Knife to a Gun Fight
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_37

english.description: Kill your first Enforcer. I'm sure this will send the Highwaymen a good message.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_38

english.description: Kill 5 enemies by throwing a shield at them.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_39

english.description: Purchase the 5th tier of a stackable perk. You can never have enough.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_40

english.description: No wings means less drag, right? Take a short flight in the wingless plane.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_41

english.description: Kill 10 brawlers with any saw launcher. They never saw it coming.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_42

english.description: Craft your first Legendary Weapon or Vehicle and start a legend of your own.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_43

english.description: Knock an enemy's helmet off with a charged melee attack.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_44

english.description: Eliminate 10 enemies within a single activation of Wrath.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_45

english.description: Perform an Aerial Takedown after using Leap of Faith.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_46

english.description: Unlock the first level for all Perks.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_47

english.description: Kill an enemy more than 100m away with a basic arrow.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_48

english.description: Finish off an Enforcer with a bayonet.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_49

english.description: Survive a 30m fall using only Leap of Faith to nullify the impact.
english.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_50

schinese.description: 协助卡米纳回到位于繁荣镇的妈妈身边。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_1

schinese.description: 升级并确保繁荣镇安全。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_2

schinese.description: 带着圣父回到新伊甸。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_3

schinese.description: 击败双胞胎，解决希望郡最大的问题。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_4

schinese.description: 决定圣父的命运。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_5

schinese.description: 取回葛蕾丝的原型枪，并欢迎她永远回归繁荣镇。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_6

schinese.description: 送回塞勒涅的珍宝储藏物。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_7

schinese.description: 帮助阿豆取回他的商业计划，让他能在繁荣镇建设情报网。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_8

schinese.description: 让尼克·莱伊与卡米纳跟纪团圆。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_9

schinese.description: 完成你首次远征，迫使拦路强盗离开据点。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_10

schinese.description: 通过与维豆百科侦察兵交谈来取得情报 10 次。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_11

schinese.description: 搜刮拦路强盗空投补给。小心一点，肯定会有守备！
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_12

schinese.description: 收集 15 株生长于希望郡的植物，这是现存最接近药局的东西。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_13

schinese.description: 搜索哨站。你可以随时抢回它。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_14

schinese.description: 投资合适的区域，初次升级繁荣镇的基础建设。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_15

schinese.description: 让汀博陪同驾驶累计 5 分钟，但不要带它去兽医那里。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_16

schinese.description: 夺取一辆乙醇运送车，将它开回你的任一哨站。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_17

schinese.description: 完成 3 个寻宝游戏任务。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_18

schinese.description: 撬开 5 个保险箱。在没有其他银行的情况下，这是你经历过最接近抢劫的事情。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_19

schinese.description: 招募所有的雇佣兵。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_20

schinese.description: 制作 10 个医疗包，它们一定能派上用场。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_21

schinese.description: 杀死一只残暴动物，只要有机会，它也会对你做同样的事。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_22

schinese.description: 在政府飞机残骸远征找到山姆·费雪服装。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_23

schinese.description: 找到所有的“亲爱的照片”位置，并且视希望郡一如往常。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_24

schinese.description: 替新世界重现甜美的曲调。找到全部隐藏的 MP3 播放器。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_25

schinese.description: 让繁荣镇发展得更胜以往！增加所有基础建设的升级。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_26

schinese.description: 从希望郡的每种动物身上至少取得一次皮，一点都不可怕。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_27

schinese.description: 完成 7 次阶级 III 难度的独特远征。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_28

schinese.description: 在未被发现的情况下，解放一个阶级 III 哨站。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_29

schinese.description: 在阶级 III 难度时，至少解放所有哨站一次。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_30

schinese.description: 制作 3 把武器，不需要外表美观，只要能发挥作用就好！
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_31

schinese.description: 成功捕捉希望郡的每一种鱼，摄取 Omega-3 脂肪酸。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_32

schinese.description: 招募赫瑞修。别介意它的坏脾气，它的猪脑有时候很固执。仅限主办人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_33

schinese.description: 使用 3 个烟雾弹。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_34

schinese.description: 使用穿甲弹爆头一名执法者。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_35

schinese.description: 在多人合作中，与一名伙伴完成 3 次远征。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_36

schinese.description: 使用任何类型的击倒杀死 25 名敌人。记得善用枕木钉！
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_37

schinese.description: 杀死第一个执法者，我很肯定这会带给拦路强盗一则强劲的消息。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_38

schinese.description: 瞄准敌人丢护盾，杀死 5 名敌人
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_39

schinese.description: 购买可堆栈特长的第 5 层级，永远也不嫌多。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_40

schinese.description: 没有机翼，表示空气阻力变小了，是吧？使用没有机翼的飞机短暂飞行。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_41

schinese.description: 使用任意锯子发射器杀死 10 名斗殴者，他们永远想不到这招。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_42

schinese.description: 制作第一件传奇武器或载具，展开自己的传奇。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_43

schinese.description: 使用强力的近距离攻击敲落敌人的头盔。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_44

schinese.description: 激发一次愤怒的过程中，杀死 10 名敌人
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_45

schinese.description: 使用信仰之跃后，接着施展空中击倒。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_46

schinese.description: 解开所有特长的初级。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_47

schinese.description: 使用基础弓箭从 100 米外杀死一名敌人。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_48

schinese.description: 使用刺刀解决一名执法者。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_49

schinese.description: 在只使用信仰之跃消除冲击的情况下，活过 30 米高的坠落。
schinese.name: FCNewDawn_Ach_50
